Fact confirmed: file_question.py:636-677 _excerpt_rows runs SELECT text, timestamp_start, timestamp_end FROM transcript_chunks and SELECT text, start_time, end_time FROM video_frame_texts. The touch list does not name these tables. However, invariant I7 requires the contents to be drawn from exactly the requested file's transcript and frame text in each section's span, so reading these tables is what the spec requires. Traceability gap only; the read itself is in scope.
